data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: code-review-graph
edge_embedded.summary: Code Review Graph 是一款本地优先的代码智能工具，通过构建代码库的持久知识图谱，让 AI 编码助手在代码审查时只关注相关部分，解决大仓库中上下文过载的问题。它利用 tree-sitter 进行静态分析，并支持增量更新，从而显著减少 LLM 的上下文负担。你可以通过 MCP 或 CLI 轻松集成，特别适合大型项目的高效、上下文感知的代码审查，与 Claude 等 AI 工具配合使用，能大幅提升审查效率。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Code Review Graph is a local-first tool that builds a persistent knowledge graph of your codebase, enabling AI coding assistants to focus only on relevant code during reviews. It uses static analysis (tree-sitter) and incremental updates to construct the graph, dramatically reducing LLM context size. Integrate via MCP or CLI for efficient, context-aware code review in large repositories, especially with Claude.

ui_devex.name: G0DM0D3
ui_devex.summary: G0DM0D3 是一个基于 TypeScript 的开源工具，旨在打破 AI 聊天的内容限制，实现无过滤的自由对话。其核心技术是通过动态提示注入和系统级修改，在不改动模型权重的前提下绕过安全层，从而解锁模型的完整表达能力。研究人员可利用它观察模型在无审查条件下的行为规律，开发者则能将其集成到需要灵活内容边界的应用中，例如创意写作或教育探索。AGPL-3.0 许可证鼓励社区贡献，以扩展对多种 AI 后端的兼容性。想体验无拘束的 AI 对话？不妨从 GitHub 仓库 clone 开始实验。
ui_devex.summary_en: G0DM0D3 is a TypeScript-based open-source tool that liberates AI chat by breaking free from built-in content restrictions, enabling unfiltered conversations with large language models. Its core technique involves dynamic prompt injection and system-level modifications that override safety layers without modifying model weights. Researchers can use it to study model behavior under uncensored conditions, while developers can integrate it into applications requiring flexible content boundaries. The AGPL-3.0 license encourages community contributions to expand compatibility with various AI backends.

framework_core.name: wigolo
framework_core.summary: Wigolo 是一个开源的 MCP 服务器，专门为 AI 编程智能体提供本地优先的网页访问能力——搜索、抓取、爬取和研究，无需依赖云 API 或付费密钥。核心技术特色是全部操作在本地运行，因此查询零成本且保护隐私。基于模型上下文协议（MCP），它可以轻松接入各类智能体框架，让智能体自主进行在线调研。开发者既可将其部署为独立服务，也可集成到现有开发工具中。典型应用包括让代码助手自动查阅文档、抓取教程或对比技术方案。
framework_core.summary_en: Wigolo is an open-source MCP server that gives AI coding agents local-first web capabilities—search, fetch, crawl, and research—without cloud APIs or API keys. Its key technical insight is running all operations locally, ensuring user privacy and zero cost per query. By leveraging the Model Context Protocol, it seamlessly integrates into agent workflows, enabling autonomous web research. Developers can deploy it as a standalone server or embed it in their tools for secure, cost-free web access.

security_safety.name: G0DM0D3
security_safety.summary: G0DM0D3 是一个基于 TypeScript 的开源工具，旨在打破 AI 聊天的内容限制，实现无过滤的自由对话。其核心技术是通过动态提示注入和系统级修改，在不改动模型权重的前提下绕过安全层，从而解锁模型的完整表达能力。研究人员可利用它观察模型在无审查条件下的行为规律，开发者则能将其集成到需要灵活内容边界的应用中，例如创意写作或教育探索。AGPL-3.0 许可证鼓励社区贡献，以扩展对多种 AI 后端的兼容性。想体验无拘束的 AI 对话？不妨从 GitHub 仓库 clone 开始实验。
security_safety.summary_en: G0DM0D3 is a TypeScript-based open-source tool that liberates AI chat by breaking free from built-in content restrictions, enabling unfiltered conversations with large language models. Its core technique involves dynamic prompt injection and system-level modifications that override safety layers without modifying model weights. Researchers can use it to study model behavior under uncensored conditions, while developers can integrate it into applications requiring flexible content boundaries. The AGPL-3.0 license encourages community contributions to expand compatibility with various AI backends.
